t: You're looking at the Rothschild Mausoleum, within West Ham Jewish Cemetery. The cemetery was established in 1856 by the New Synagogue on Great St. Helen's, soon joined by the Great Synagogue in Duke's Place. It has been closed to new burials since 2002. Baron Ferdinand de Rothschild is buried here. He was a banker, art collector and Liberal Unionist Member of Parliament from 1885 to 1898. When he died, his sister Alice inherited Waddesdon Manor and kept his collections there.
